searchText: Hi everyone, how do i run the devnet6 in my infrastructure. Is there any guide or references for help to setup the consensys node as well as the execution node in my local? Its still in a pre-launch state, i'd probably wait till more clients are on there and it feels more stable unless there's something you want to urgently test <@199561711278227457> thanks for the update. Not something that i need to urgently test, just curious to learn more about it. If you have ever participated in any earlier devnets/testnets, its going to be quite similar. We provide a genesis.ssz and you can set that as the initial state, and sync off of other peers provided here: https://4844-devnet-6.ethpandaops.io Thanks <@412614104222531604>
